text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Kashiwa Kinen. Hokko 
Tarumae focused intently on her final 
preparations. The tense, precarious edge 
from before was gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at last, race day arrives. Seeing her 
dignified presence in the paddock, the 
fans clearly sense a change within her!
